title: VACCINATION CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL = CERTIFICATS DE VACCINATION EXIGÉS DANS LES VOYAGES INTERNATIONAUX

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: A bilingual amendment to the 1974 vaccination certificate requirements, correcting the validity of Saudi Arabia's cholera certificate during the 1974–1975 mass gathering season to six months rather than three.

sections.extract: VACCINATION CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL Amendment to 1974 publication Saadi Arabia In the note1 concerning cholera vaccination certificate requirements during the season of periodic mass congregation (16 October 1974 to 12 January 1975) amend the period of validity of the certificate to read six months instead of three months. CERTIFICATS DE VACCINATION EXIGÉS DANS LES VOYAGES INTERNATIONAUX
